No new console errors — only pre-existing GoldAPI 403 warning + pre-existing RN-Web deprecation warnings (shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents/useNativeDriver) documented as known P2 pre-existing.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:2081 — dashboard_now_brief uses Depends(get_current_user) so auth is enforced (401 confirmed). Fallback string in except branch correctly preserves 'Good {tod} {salutation}!' + '👉' contract so testing_agent's assertion #1 still holds if LLM is down.

now-brief-card.tsx:69 — useEffect deps intentionally empty (comment explains). This is fine given the internal 5-min cache intent, but note that if pending/inTransit/etc. change (e.g. after pull-to-refresh), the brief does NOT auto-regenerate unless user taps the refresh icon. Acceptable per spec.
vault-snapshot-section.tsx:59 — 'gold_baht || gold_bt' field-name fallback via `any` cast is fragile; consider adding a proper union type once schema stabilises.
vault-snapshot-section.tsx:156 — grams conversion uses factor 15.244 (1 baht ≈ 15.244 g); consistent with existing bullion module conventions.
